chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakuni:
Indeed, ʿAlī عليه السلام used to reject a gift in a will, and whatever one acknowledged at the time of his death without proof and without evidence, he rejected it.

key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةِ: the will or bequest made at death

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule about gifts or claims mentioned in a will without proof?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding financial claims made in connection with a dying person’s will. It indicates that gifts or acknowledgements lacking established proof or clear evidence were not accepted, reflecting caution in protecting rights and preventing unverified claims.
